supports.excerpt:
Camel AI
Track and analyze CAMEL agents with full observability. Set an `AGENTOPS_API_KEY` in your environment and initialize AgentOps to get started.

- [Camel AI](https://www.camel-ai.org/) - Advanced agent communication framework
- [AgentOps integration example](https://docs.agentops.ai/v1/integrations/camel)
- [Official Camel AI documentation](https://docs.camel-ai.org/cookbooks/agents_tracking.html)

Installation

metadata.objective: Enable observability and tracking for multi-agent systems
metadata.section_summary: Build multi-agent systems with tools, handoffs, and guardrails. AgentOps natively integrates with the OpenAI Agents SDKs for both Python and TypeScript.

skill_drafts.name: AgentOps Integration Setup
skill_drafts.description: Initialize AgentOps observability for agent frameworks by setting environment API key and configuring integration. Use when onboarding a new agent system that requires tracking and analysis of agent behavior and communications.
skill_drafts.objective: Enable observability and tracking for multi-agent systems
contraindications: Agent framework already has native observability built-in
AGENTOPS_API_KEY not available or not provisioned
Observability not required for use case
Agent system operates in air-gapped or offline environment
intervention_moves: Initialize AgentOps client in agent framework code
Verify dashboard connection and data flow
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Set AGENTOPS_API_KEY in environment', 'detail': 'Configure environment variable with valid AgentOps API key'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Initialize AgentOps', 'detail': 'Call AgentOps initialization in agent framework code'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Verify connection', 'detail': 'Confirm observability dashboard receives agent telemetry'}
triggers: Starting integration with supported agent framework (Camel AI, CrewAI, Langchain, etc.)
Need full observability of agent behavior and communications
constraints: Valid API key must be set before initialization
Agent framework must be one of AgentOps-supported integrations
Network connectivity required to observability dashboard
cautions: Ensure API key is not committed to version control
Verify environment variable is set in all deployment environments
output_contract: AgentOps initialized and connected; agent actions and communications tracked in observability dashboard; telemetry data flowing to monitoring system

metadata.prompt:
1. Set AGENTOPS_API_KEY in your environment.
2. Initialize AgentOps in your agent framework code.
3. Verify connection to observability dashboard.
4. Confirm agent actions and communications are being tracked.
